agent.result_text:
There's now an "Export pools (CSV)" button (`data-testid="export-pools"`) in the Pools section, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 acceptance tests.

The button downloads `pools.csv`. It starts with the header line `pool,member,share,cut`, then has one line per member. Pools and their members are both in the order they were added. A pool that is a member is written as `pool:<name>`, and the cut is written as shown on screen, or left empty when there is none. A field that contains a comma or quote is put in quotes (e.g. `"Lee, Jo"`).

Retiring a person doesn't make the screen re-read the pools, so a cut on screen can be out of date. The export therefore re-reads the pools from the store before writing the file. That way the cuts in the file match what's stored, and the test's second export, after a retirement, depends on this.

The change is only in the front end, in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/pools.ts`. The server and the stored data didn't need to change, because the existing pools endpoint already returns members in order with their shares and cuts. I added a small CSV quoting helper in `pools.ts` rather than sharing the one in `people.ts`, because importing from `people.ts` would make the two files import each other.
